searchText: With regards to attending the in-person events mentioned on the core dev call [Community Call*], could I request a channel where these events are posted (and possibly deals on tickets or reserved tickets so they aren't sold out by the time lurkers in the channel hear about them). Also during meetings could you have the person whose speaking say his name first so we know who is speaking? > With regards to attending the in-person events mentioned on the core dev call Do you have an example? Of an event? (Sorry this was the community call not the core dev call). ETH SF, Consensus, or Montreal. I think weekinethereum tends to list them? Interested in launching validator before merge of Ropsten - see comment about documentation here (at bottom): https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/525 - is this the best place to watch for updates on documentation/resources for interested validators? We’ll have a post up on blog.ethereum.org and make sure to share it in <#595701770034872362>
